annotation.title_clean: 京经信发〔2025〕44号(excerpt: 通过安全评估1年内未向交通运输部门申请开展道路应用试点的)
annotation.title_en: Beijing Municipal Commission of Economy and Information Technology Document No. 44 (2025) – excerpt on road-application pilots after safety assessment
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Beijing Municipal Commission of Economy and Information Technology (inferred from document number 京经信发)
annotation.summary_en: Fragment of a Beijing municipal document (No. 44, 24 Oct 2025) listing a condition, likely for withdrawing or cancelling a safety assessment result, where an entity has not applied to transport authorities for a road-application pilot within one year of passing the safety assessment. Likely concerns autonomous vehicles; the excerpt is too short to be certain.
key_provisions_or_claims: Item (4): failing to apply to transport authorities for a road-application pilot within one year of passing the safety assessment triggers a consequence (likely revocation or invalidation).
Links safety assessment to subsequent road-pilot approval by transport authorities.
